bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities, embedding trust and compliance into partner-delivered technical solutions.

Built a shared-responsibility operating-model framework clarifying AWS-owned versus insurer-owned controls, creating a reusable guardrail structure that let regulated customers adopt cloud AI capabilities with confidence.

Led AWS modernization execution for monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads, converting complex legacy environments into a repeatable migration pattern applicable across partner-delivered deployments.
